description: Last login timestamp currently stored as string (intended as datetime64[ns]), spanning from 2019-01-01 to 2024-05-12. All 30 records are complete with no missing values. All observed values consistently display a midnight time component (00:00:00). Two records share identical timestamps (2023-07-10 and 2023-11-17), indicating multiple users logged in on the same dates.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert data type from string to datetime64[ns] while preserving values: '2023-03-30 00:00:00' (string) → 2023-03-30 00:00:00 (datetime).
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values follow the format: 4-digit year, 2-digit month, 2-digit day, followed by 00:00:00 time component — e.g., '2023-03-30 00:00:00'.
[CLARIFY] Confirm whether the universal '00:00:00' time component indicates date-only tracking (with time truncated) or actual midnight login events.
